Hello, all
I'm trying to test the correlation of the diet and allometric trajectories of the pitviper skulls, in a phylogenetic context, similar to Esquerré, et al. 2017  (https://www.jstor.org/stable/48575235?seq=9).
I would like to know how to extract the slope information by species for further procD.pgls analyses or phylogenetic ANCOVA. 
I had already run an ANCOVA comparing slopes among species, and pairwise compared it: 
HoS_test<-rocD.lm(Sk_shape~Class_Csize$skull_GPA.Csize*Class_Csize$SPECIE,iter=999)
summary(HoS_test)
Pairwise<-pairwise(HoS_test, covariate = Class_Csize$skull_GPA.Csize, groups=Class_Csize$SPECIE)
PW<-summary(Pairwise, test.type = 'var'). 

Thanks for the attention!

If you save your object as ‘fit’, the coefficients are in $pgls.coefficients .  Example:

 

fit <- procD.plgs(Y.gpa$coords ~ Csize, phy = phy, data = gdf)

fit$pgls.coefficients

 

Dean
